name: Lightbox Carousel
description: Vertical 3D ring of image cards that auto-rotates and can be dragged up or down. Clicking a card opens the image in a fullscreen lightbox overlay.
contents: Rotating 3D ring of glowing image cards
Fullscreen lightbox overlay with close button
behavior: Ring rotates one step on an interval and pauses on hover, drag or open lightbox
Drag with mouse or touch vertically to rotate the ring
Click a card to open its image in a fading overlay, click backdrop or X to close
Cards have a pulsing glow behind them
editableByProps: Images and their alt text, number of cards
Ring and card sizes, radius, perspective, rotation delay, drag sensitivity
Background and overlay colors, close button color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glow color or pulse speed
needsCodeEdit.where: before: classes on the card div and the pulseGlow keyframes
rotateX transforms in applyRotation and the card style

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Lightbox overlay is position fixed over the whole viewport
Window mouseup and touchend listeners are added while mounted and removed on unmount
